front.title: A YANG Data Model for Performance Monitoring (PM) Collection

abstract.t: This document specifies a YANG data model for the collection of Performance Monitoring (PM) data, based on the collection requirements of the performance management function defined in ITU-T G.7710. The model processes raw performance data sampled at a network node and produces structured data that can be retrieved by clients via pull-based mechanisms or delivered via push-based mechanisms such as YANG-Push. This document does not define new performance metrics; the base metrics are those of the IPPM framework, and the model specifies the collection and exposure of the operationally important subset.
